# Gender Predictor

> Free baby gender prediction tool combining 9 methods: Chinese calendar, Ramzi theory, nub theory, heart rate, old wives tales, baking soda test, skull theory, ring test, and gut feeling. All predictions run in the browser for entertainment purposes only and are not medical advice.

## Tool
- [Home](https://gender-predictor.com): Main prediction tool with all 9 methods combined, plus baby name finder and countdown timer. Works for conceptions in 2026 and 2027 (the Chinese gender chart itself never changes year to year).

## Methods
- [Chinese Gender Chart](https://gender-predictor.com/chinese-gender-chart/): Chinese gender calendar predictor with full calendar table
- [Baking Soda Gender Test](https://gender-predictor.com/baking-soda-gender-test/): Baking soda gender test guide and interactive predictor
- [Ring Gender Test](https://gender-predictor.com/ring-gender-test/): Wedding ring pendulum test guide
- [Baby Gender Prediction Quiz](https://gender-predictor.com/baby-gender-prediction-quiz/): 15-question old wives tales quiz
- [Boy or Girl Quiz](https://gender-predictor.com/boy-or-girl-quiz/): Quick boy or girl prediction quiz
